title: Plan from above
what: A top view of the hall: the stage with two trusses, lamps, a rug, monitors, speakers and cables; a pit; and a fan of about 540 seats in arcs with three aisles, head dots, exits with door swings and a sound desk. The followspot looks down on one round pool of light.
why: It is the only view where you can count the room: 500-600 seats are literally on the page, and one round spot on the stage is the only blue thing. From above, the beam reads as a clean cone and the spot as a stage mark that is yours.
how: Seats are generated on arcs around the stage centre, each a tiny cushion and back rotated to face it, with aisles cut out; a faint foh truss crosses the house. The pointer moves the round pool anywhere on the stage, the lamp rotates in plan and the cone is redrawn; board lines inside the pool turn blue. Draw-in on entry, static under reduced motion; on mobile the head dots drop out.
